title: Duolingo Lesson Skip Friction
dataSources: Reviews (`language:review`), lessons (`language:lesson`), immersion sessions (`language:immersion`), tutor sessions (`language:tutor`), sync states (`language:sync`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Anki review logs, Duolingo lessons, Babbel course exports, immersion-hour trackers, and tutor-session notes — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=language:lesson course=* lesson_skipped=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(lesson_skipped="yes",1,0))) as matched by course
| eval a_skipped_lesson_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_skipped_lesson_pct
description: Measures the percentage of Duolingo lesson attempts that end with a skipped lesson by course.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which course are helping or hurting Duolingo lesson attempts.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a skipped lesson` on `language:lesson` events and summarize the hit rate by `course`.
visualization: Table of course with percentage of Duolingo lesson attempts ending with a skipped lesson.
grandmaExplanation: It records how often a skipped lesson happens for each course so you can see where Duolingo lesson attempts go smoothly or get stuck.
